note: Text one player sends the others during a match. Messages players exchange outside a match do not travel on this connection at all.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the sender.

fields.name: netId
fields.note: The entity a receiving end attributes the text to where the seat does not name one. Where the seat names a speaker, that is what a receiving end uses instead.

fields.name: localized
fields.note: Whether the text is a phrase to show as it stands, or a key naming one the receiving end looks up and fills in from the parameters. Both ends send it clear.

fields.name: paramsLength
fields.note: How many bytes of the run that follows carry meaning.

fields.name: textLength
fields.note: The length of the text, counted in bytes and excluding the byte that ends it. A 4.17 client sends at most 255 bytes of text. A client shows the text to its first zero byte.

fields.name: params
fields.note: Thirty two bytes holding text that fills in a key, ended by a zero byte within them. The bytes after that zero byte carry no meaning, so two messages otherwise alike can differ in them.

fields.name: text
fields.note: The text, textLength bytes of it.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text.
